title: Build your character, environment (kitchen), props (ingredients), and…
content: Build your character, environment (kitchen), props (ingredients), and action/progression (pizza steps) as separate visual reference assets, then use Seedance 2.5 Omni in PixVerse Canvas to combine them into a single continuous animation/film.
tips: Build your character, environment (kitchen), props (ingredients), and action/progression (pizza steps) as separate visual reference assets, then use Seedance 2.5 Omni in PixVerse Canvas to combine them into a single continuous animation/film.

es.content: Construye tu personaje, el entorno (cocina), los props (ingredientes) y la acción/progresión (pasos de la pizza) como recursos visuales de referencia separados, y luego usa Seedance 2.5 Omni en PixVerse Canvas para combinarlos en una sola animación/película continua.

fr.content: Créez votre personnage, votre environnement (cuisine), vos accessoires (ingrédients) et votre action/progression (étapes de préparation de la pizza) sous forme d’assets de référence visuelle distincts, puis utilisez Seedance 2.5 Omni dans PixVerse Canvas pour les combiner en une seule animation/vidéo continue.

ja.content: キャラクター、環境（キッチン）、小道具（食材）、アクション／進行（ピザの手順）をそれぞれ別々のビジュアルリファレンス素材として作成し、その後、PixVerse Canvas の Seedance 2.5 Omni を使って、それらを1本の連続したアニメーション／映像に統合します。

ko.content: 캐릭터, 환경(주방), 소품(재료), 액션/진행 과정(피자 단계)을 각각 별도의 시각적 레퍼런스 에셋으로 만든 다음, PixVerse Canvas의 Seedance 2.5 Omni를 사용해 이를 하나의 연속적인 애니메이션/필름으로 결합하세요.

pt.content: Construa seu personagem, ambiente (cozinha), props (ingredientes) e ação/progressão (etapas da pizza) como assets visuais de referência separados e, em seguida, use o Seedance 2.5 Omni no PixVerse Canvas para combiná-los em uma única animação/filme contínuo.

zh.content: 将你的角色、环境（厨房）、道具（食材）和动作/进程（披萨制作步骤）分别构建为独立的视觉参考素材，然后在 PixVerse Canvas 中使用 Seedance 2.5 Omni 将它们合成为一个连续的动画/影片。
